description: The providers this customer follows on Speedi, and whether each has set a live light. Use when somebody asks about their OWN providers, in any words — "my people", "my favourites", "my preferred", "my regulars", "my usual plumber", "the ones I have used before", "who do I normally use". Signing in is handled by this tool: if the customer is not connected it returns a sign-in prompt rather than an error, so it is safe to call before knowing. Read-only.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

onlyFreeNow.description: Only those free right now. Defaults to all of them.
